description:
Reads a compact V2 campaign identity and exact current sequence without reserving or consuming a redemption.
Use when: starting an explicit new action after prior outcomes are resolved; persist the returned intent before horizon_redeem_gift_code.
Not for: recovering an uncertain action; retry its saved original intent with horizon_redeem_gift_code instead.
Requires: userId and the player's session: sign in with horizon_signin_email or horizon_signin_anonymous and pass its accessToken as sessionToken.
Side effects: None (read only); no server intent or reservation is stored.
Returns: {valid,intent}; intent is null when invalid, otherwise exactly protocolVersion,projectScope,userId,code,campaignId,expectedCount,configRevision. Counts/revisions are exact Int64 decimal strings; projectScope binds the local host/project without exposing credentials. Persist all seven fields, never the session token.
Errors: 409 UPGRADE_REQUIRED closes V1; MIGRATION_REQUIRED needs operator migration; COUNT_AHEAD, CAMPAIGN_CHANGED, COUNTER_EXHAUSTED and STATE_CONFLICT require explicit reconciliation. Keep the original intent on every uncertain outcome, never prepare or advance automatically. 401 means the session is missing or expired: sign in again and retry with the new accessToken. 403 for a session means the token belongs to another user: pass the userId that signed in. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

code.description: Original visible gift code, retained with the prepared campaign identity

sessionToken.description: Current accessToken of the intent's original user, sent only as a Bearer header

userId.description: Player user ID (UUID) from horizon_signup_* or horizon_signin_*
